facts.text: The matter is the proposed refusal to grant building consent amendment BCO10347592-B for recladding a relocated dwelling.
The amendment would retain existing timber joinery alongside new plywood cladding.
The section is located in a low wind zone on a rear section sloping down from the road.
The designer states the new plywood and batten cladding is to be installed in accordance with E2/AS1.
Figures 2 and 3 show the jamb and sill details as shown in the plans.
